business_problem: build a single source of truth that could keep pace with Huel’s rapid growth, automate key data processes, and link ecommerce and retail insight across the business.
solution_summary: Huel uses Snowflake on Snowflake to build a single source of truth that could keep pace with Huel’s rapid growth, automate key data processes, and link ecommerce and retail insight across the business. Product, commerce, customer, and supply-chain data are centralized in Snowflake so business users and data teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. The platform also connects with AWS, dbt so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Huel achieved 200 hours saved per month and 2 years of Snowflake, paid for in one query.
